title: Local reconstruction of coefficients in quantitative photo-acoustic tomography
summary: We study the problem of reconstructing the scattering and absorption coefficients in the radiative transport equation using internal data in quantitative photo-acoustic tomography (QPAT). In practical settings, however, this internal data is only partially available near the boundary, owing to medium's strong absorption and limitations of the measurement equipment. Our main contribution is the development of a method to recover these coefficients within a subregion where the internal data can be obtained with sufficient reliability.
